_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.56.0 (no selected connection, pools under the client's id, JSON-function masking leak, origin check); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.76.0 (one connection id per tab, edits and runs keep their database, Tidy renamed Format). beamlynx-ui 0.76.0 needs pine-lang 0.56 (its RequiredVersion).
